messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SECURITY ALERT — High egress to unknown S3 endpoints observed from auth-service.

incident-bot: Top signals: high-volume PUT/GET to s3://external-bkp-logs-01 from IPs 204.89.12.45 & 45.33.22.11; auth-service pods (auth-prod-*) showing repeated credential retrieval logs. Alert threshold crossed at 2026-03-14T02:32:00Z; request rate 1200/min.

olivia (oncall): I'm on it. Paging secops and eng-sre. Taking ownership for initial triage.

mike (secops): @olivia on my way. Can you confirm whether these are internal backups or external buckets? Also any signs of lateral movement?

alex (eng-sre): Looking at svc logs. I can see repeated calls to our S3 client with header Authorization: Bearer <redacted>. Sample log:
```
2026-03-14T02:30:41Z auth-prod-3 GET https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/external-bkp-logs-01/2026-03-14.log 200 4521
headers: {
  "x-request-id": "a1b2c3",
  "authorization": "Bearer eyJhbGci..."
}
```

alex (eng-sre): The tokens in logs look like short-lived service tokens issued by the legacy session proxy. That proxy was supposed to redact tokens, but I see debug-level logging enabled in a recent deploy (rolled 02:10Z).

olivia (oncall): :grimacing: ok stop deploys. @deploy-bot pause deploys for auth-service now.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline paused for service=auth-service by request of @olivia at 02:34Z.

mike (secops): Immediate mitigation plan:
1) Revoke session-proxy service token issuer keys (rotate rotated immediately).
2) Throttle outbound egress for auth-service in prod security groups.
3) Cordon and restart auth-prod pods (to clear in-memory tokens).
4) Identify suspected exfil timeframe and enumerate affected customer IDs.

sarah (product-support): We'll need to know which customers had traffic during window. I can prepare a customer-impact matrix once we have the list of user IDs.

alex (eng-sre): Running commands now:
```
# revoke issuer key in KMS
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id "alias/session-proxy-issuer" --pending-window-in-days 7
# quick rotate: generate new signing key and update proxy config
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/session-proxy SIGNING_KEY=new-key-ref
```

alex (eng-sre): Also applying egress deny list for auth namespace:
```
kubectl -n prod patch networkpolicy auth-egress -p '{"spec":{"egress":[{"to":[{"ipBlock":{"cidr":"0.0.0.0/0"}}],"ports":[]}]}}'
# fallback: attach temporary egress SG to nodes
```

mike (secops): Do NOT schedule KMS deletion until we coordinate rotation. Use immediate rotation workflow: mark old key compromised, import new key, update proxies, then retire old.

olivia (oncall): Action items assigned:
- olivia: coordinate live mitigation + SRE ops (cordon/restart)
- alex: rotate session-proxy signing key and push config
- mike: run forensic capture on auth-prod nodes and enumerate egress IPs
- sarah: prepare customer-impact template and hold drafts
- jason (legal): stand by for breach counsel

jason (legal): Please preserve all logs and disable any auto-delete. Legal needs timing and estimated rows of PII touched. Notify me when we have a list of customer IDs.

mike (secops): Forensic checklist running: collecting /var/log/auth-client.log, network flow logs, and S3 access logs. Suspect files: any debug dump starts with "debug-dump-". Early analysis shows three files uploaded 02:28:xx -> external-bkp-logs-01.

sarah (product-support): Draft notification snippet (holding):
"We detected unusual outbound traffic from the authentication service between 02:25–02:35 UTC. We are actively investigating and have taken containment actions. We will notify affected customers with details once the scope is confirmed."

olivia (oncall): Temporary status page note: "Investigating suspected outbound data exfiltration from auth-service. Potential customer-impacting activity. We have paused deploys and are rotating keys. More updates in 30m."

mike (secops): Query I ran to list objects:
```
aws s3api list-objects --bucket external-bkp-logs-01 --prefix 2026-03-14 | jq '.Contents[] | {Key: .Key, LastModified: .LastModified, Size: .Size}'
```
Result: three objects: debug-dump-1.log (1.2MB), debug-dump-2.log (900KB), redacted-credentials.log (120KB)

alex (eng-sre): Confirmed debug logging flag was toggled by automation script at 02:09Z in the auth-service deploy. Rolling back that config for now.

olivia (oncall): Revoke tokens command (internal tooling):
```
./tools/revoke-session-tokens --service session-proxy --reason "compromise suspected" --env prod
```
Run once rotation in place.

mike (secops): We should rotate all service-account tokens used by auth-service and any long-lived credentials. Also rotate downstream DB credentials if there's any sign they were accessed.

sarah (product-support): Who owns the follow-up customer comms? I can draft and coordinate approvals.

jason (legal): @sarah coordinate with me on language. We'll need to follow GDPR notification thresholds if PII is confirmed.

olivia (oncall): Timeboxed next update 02:50Z. Current severity = P1. Creating incident ticket: INC-2026-4032 and linking.

olivia (oncall): Assigning postmortem owner: alex (eng-sre).

alex (eng-sre): Oncall handoff note for next shift: leave doc with mitigation steps, keys rotated? yes/no, forensic artifacts location: s3://redwood-forensics/inc-2026-4032/. I'll add checklist.

mike (secops): Preliminary scope: objects contain debug output including truncated session tokens and user IDs (hashed). We are treating this as data exposure; presume customer notification required until proven otherwise.

sarah (product-support): I'll prepare an FAQ draft and identify customers with high sensitivity flags first.

olivia (oncall): Good work. Keep comments short. If anyone needs to escalate to execs, ping @ceo and @vp-engineering with subject line: SECURITY INCIDENT — auth-service egress. :exclamation:

deploy-bot: Noted — deploys resume blocked until manual unblock by @olivia.

mike (secops): Next steps summary (for status page and execs):
- Containment: paused deploys, rotated signing key, revoked session tokens, cordoned/restarted pods, blocked outbound egress to suspect buckets.
- Forensic: collected logs, listed and quarantined 3 suspect objects, snapshot nodes.
- Remediation: plan to rotate all related credentials, remove debug logging flag from automation, update redaction in session-proxy, add egress allowlist.
- Communication: customer notification draft + legal review; status page updated.

olivia (oncall): Next update at 02:50Z or when we hit a new milestone. If anyone opens a new thread, reference INC-2026-4032.
